name: Ergi
source:
Ergi is an adventure romance visual novel set in a post-apocalyptic Nordic world. The protagonist, Britt, is coming of age and hoping to reunite with his family and friends. 

[Edited from [url=https://kkchar.itch.io/ergi]Itch.io[/url]]
